itemUsage.en: Hadiya, descendant of Sargonian warriors, on her way to challenge the wilds to rebuild her tribe.
itemUsage.zh: 萨尔贡战士的后裔哈蒂娅，为重建部族踏上挑战荒野的征途。

itemDesc.en: She staunchly believes that even a foreign blade can remind people of legends forgotten by the desert sands.
itemDesc.zh: 她坚信即便是一柄异乡之剑，也能让人们回忆起那被沙漠遗忘了的传说。

description.en:
Consumes <@ba.vdown>10</> DP to fuse sword and staff, gaining <@ba.vup>increased</> Attack Range, <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> ATK, and attacking up to <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target:0}</> targets simultaneously; 
When skill is active, can spend <@ba.vdown>15</> DP to activate <$ba.alter>Equipment Alteration</>, extending skill duration by <@ba.vup>15</> seconds
description.zh: 消耗<@ba.vdown>10</>点部署费用组合剑和杖，攻击范围<@ba.vup>扩大</>，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，同时攻击<@ba.vup>{attack@max_target:0}</>个目标；\n技能期间可消耗<@ba.vdown>15</>点部署费用使用<$ba.alter>装备应变</>，延长<@ba.vup>15</>秒技能持续时间
